summary: Small selector lookup: given an integer selector passed in the this register, returns one of two static object addresses, or a null pointer for any other value. Selector 0 maps to the object at 0x008D3984, selector 1 maps to the object at 0x008D3980, and any other value returns 0. Called by VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader, suggesting it selects a per-type static configuration object during vehicle joint-system loading.

operations.description: First selector test: when the selector value (this) is 0, the function returns the static object at 0x008D3984.
Second selector test: when the selector value (this) equals 1, the function returns the static object at 0x008D3980.
Fallback return of 0 (null pointer) for any selector value other than 0 or 1.
Invoked by VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader as the static object selector while building the vehicle physics joint system.

unresolved: The types and contents of the two static objects at 0x008D3980 and 0x008D3984 are not described by this packet.
Whether the selector is a joint-type enum or a configuration index depends on the caller's contract in VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader.
